votes.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

posts.text:
Nearly 60,000 veterans call Alabama's Fifth Congressional District home, and their service is a lasting part of what makes North Alabama so special.

On Veterans Day, we recognize the men and women who have worn our nation's uniform and the families who have stood beside them. Their courage, sacrifice, and love of country deserve our gratitude today and every day.

To all who have served, thank you. May God bless our veterans.

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on being elected House Republican Leader for the 120th Congress!

Jim is a strong conservative and a fighter for the principles we share. I've appreciated the opportunity to work alongside him and look forward to continuing that work as we keep our Conference united and focused on the priorities that matter most to the American people.

I'm glad to see nearly $200 million in additional funding awarded to Alabama through the Rural Health Transformation Program!

Made possible by the Working Families Tax Cut, our state has now been awarded more than $400 million to strengthen rural healthcare and support the

Nearly $19 million in federal support is going toward North Alabama's new veterans cemetery in Madison County!

This was the largest individual cemetery grant awarded by the VA nationwide this year.

After recently breaking ground on this long-awaited project, I'm glad to see this investment moving forward.
https://t.co/avAw3ZDQhi

North Alabama students, there's still time to enter the 2026 Congressional App Challenge!

I encourage middle and high school students across the Fifth District to put their skills and creativity to the test. I look forward to seeing the creativity and talent our students bring to this year's competition!

The deadline is October 26. Learn more here: https://t.co/A22DIlMEyr

I was proud to secure $1.2 million to modernize Lawrence County’s 911 radio system.

As a former firefighter, I know firsthand how important reliable communication is during an emergency. These upgrades will help our first responders do their jobs safely and better protect our communities.
https://t.co/oqYEhHcj1A

It was an honor to recognize North Alabama hero Major Mike Connelly, who risked his own life under enemy fire to save fellow American service members in Afghanistan.

Thank you, Major Connelly, for your extraordinary courage and service to our great nation!
https://t.co/xHJP1oLMZb

North Alabama is seeing another major investment! Nucor is investing $60 million to expand its manufacturing operations in Morgan County.

This is great news for Alabama's Fifth District and a testament to the strength of our local workforce. Thank you, @GovernorKayIvey, for your

Congratulations to Stephen Cash on being named Director of NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center!

Marshall has long been at the heart of our nation’s space program, and its work is a source of tremendous pride for North Alabama. I look forward to working with Director Cash to build on that legacy and keep Marshall leading the way in American space exploration.
With severe weather on the way for North Alabama this weekend, please stay safe, stay weather aware, and take a moment to review your safety plans. https://t.co/h82IZi4RPJ

$5.5 billion in economic impact and thousands of jobs supported - @hudsonalpha is a great example of what makes North Alabama special: world-class research, a highly skilled workforce, and innovation that creates jobs and strengthens our economy.
 
Proud to have them in our community. https://t.co/DidqpkXnVf
Thank you, @GovernorKayIvey, for your leadership. You are exactly right — North Alabama is prepared to forge the next chapter of U.S. space superiority. https://t.co/HsE2LTAJWs

It is imperative that we work toward delivering on the next generation of radar system that will serve our region. I will continue working to ensure we have reliable, timely coverage for our communities across North Alabama. https://t.co/5zLfBlWsbF

I am proud to have secured $2 million dollars for Huntsville International’s West Aviation Center Project. 

This investment will enhance one of the pillars of our community and further strengthen North Alabama as an economic hub for defense, aerospace, and advanced manufacturing. https://t.co/a1QDk9I08S

As North Alabama’s national security contributions continue to grow, so does our need for infrastructure to support the people and places who carry out those missions.

This $10.8 million federal grant for the Resolute Way Interchange project will improve access to Redstone Arsenal and ease congestion, ensuring North Alabama is prepared to support that growth. https://t.co/zWBpElR9fq
I am proud our entire delegation stands united in making the case for North Alabama to be the future home of U.S. Space Academy. https://t.co/x0nIN645QM
I am grateful for the support of our entire delegation in highlighting why North Alabama is the perfect location for U.S. Space Academy. https://t.co/ULKYDtxK9k

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
